verdict.rationale: Antigravity's 'Projects' feature groups folders/repos to give an individual agent session context, and Remote Control lets a user access their own sessions remotely, but there is no evidence of a multi-user shared workspace, team-level project sharing, or admin-controlled common source of truth across an engineering team. The product is framed as a single-developer agentic IDE/CLI, not a team collaboration or knowledge-base platform.
